action.goal: clip(bouncer_goal + scale * clip(action, -clip, clip), joint_lower, joint_upper)

observation.layout: terms concatenated in this order; a term with history h contributes h frames, oldest first; after a reset every frame equals the first value

terms.name: joint_pos
terms.doc: Encoder angles relative to the ready pose (5).

terms.name: paddle
terms.doc: Blade face centre relative to its target, face normal, face velocity, from the encoders (9).

terms.name: ball
terms.doc: Ball filter estimate: position relative to the impact target, velocity, position / velocity std, time since the last detection (capped at 0.5 s), tracked flag (10).

terms.name: impact
terms.doc: Predicted crossing of the hitting plane on a converged track: time to it (capped at 1.2 s), position relative to the target, incoming velocity, valid flag (7).

terms.name: actions
terms.doc: policy output of the previous steps (raw, unscaled)

terms.name: history
terms.doc: 0.64 s of frames (one per 40 ms): ball estimate and velocity, tracked flag, blade face height and vertical speed, predicted time to the hitting plane (160).

terms.name: bouncer
terms.doc: Scripted bouncer goal relative to ready, and time to its planned impact (capped to [-0.2, 1.2] s) (6).

terms.name: memory
terms.doc: This rally's last 6 bounces, newest first, 14 numbers each: state (1 scored, 0.5 unscored, 0 empty), age, face lean at the bounce by the encoders (2), blade speed along its normal, landing point from the face centre (2), speed in, velocity out (3), surprise = velocity out minus the filter's prediction (3); then the mean sideways surprise of the scored ones (2) and their count / 10 (87).
